findings.text: The browser step of S-04 says «answer questions 1, 2 and 3 and press Назад twice (from question 3, then from question 2)», but after the answer to question 3 the page asks question 4, so the first Назад goes from question 4 to question 3. The expected result (desk 2, then the door) fits only a start at question 3. The runner did both: variant B (answers 1 and 2, then Назад from question 3 and from question 2: desk 2, the door) and variant C (answers 1, 2, 3, then Назад three times: desk 3 without a walk, desk 2, the door); all PASS. BA-ANALYST: make the wording one thing at the next edit of the file.

With the theme button on «Авто» the page followed the system setting of this computer, which is dark, so on the cells that start at «Светлая» the sequence was light, dark, dark(Авто), light and the picture changed on two presses of three; on the cells that start at «Тёмная» the first press changed nothing in the picture (Авто is dark here). The picture followed the page colours every time; the count of frames after one change was 1 (0 when nothing changed), as the look 10 says.

Scale of the measure: at 1470 px the stage box is 1455 px wide because the emulated window keeps a 15 px vertical scrollbar (scrollWidth = clientWidth = 1455 against innerWidth 1470); the criterion's «left at least 0, right at most innerWidth» and «no horizontal scroll» hold.
